$comment: Lighthouse CI, mobile defaults (SCAN-1138, tightened SCAN-1234). The sibling of lighthouserc.json, which
keeps gating four anonymous marketing pages on the desktop preset.
WHY A SECOND FILE. One lighthouse-ci config carries one settings object, so mobile needs its own file.
Lighthouse defaults to mobile emulation; there is no mobile preset in its CLI.
WHAT IS MEASURED. Four URLs, listed in the `Lighthouse (mobile, member shell)` step of
.github/workflows/e2e.yml: `/` (the marketing home on a phone), `/feed` signed out (the REAL member
shell with the viewer drawn as Anonymous, lib/nav/anon-feed.ts, SCAN-889), `/create-a-space` and
`/themes/nocturne`.
WHAT IS GATED, AND WHAT IS ONLY MEASURED. `matchingUrlPattern` scopes every assertion below to `/` and
`/feed`, the two URLs that have readings. `/create-a-space` and `/themes/nocturne` joined in SCAN-1234
with no mobile reading at all, so they are collected and reported and cannot fail the job. A gate set
on a guess is how ADR-930 went wrong. Once they have three or four runs in the job summary, widen the
pattern (or move to an assertMatrix with a line per URL).
THE MEASURED BASELINE (lighthouse job on three previews, 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-06, median of 3 runs
URL     LCP (three jobs)        TBT (three jobs)     CLS     Script
/       4755 / 4968 / 4909 ms   194 / 427 / 291 ms   0.000   under the 600 KB line (value not logged)
How each number was chosen:
LCP 10000, error. About 2x the home median (4909) and 1.6x the /feed median (6305). The spread across
three previews on three days was under 5 percent, so 1.6x is far outside noise. It is a
'nothing collapsed' alarm, not the field budget: the old 4000 warn was already breached
on every run, so flipping THAT number to error would have failed every labelled PR.
CLS 0.1,   error. Measured 0.000 on both. 0.1 is the field budget and the good / needs-improvement
line, held for the same reason lighthouserc.json holds it.
TBT 600,   warn. One job read / at 427 and the next at 194: on a shared runner under 4x CPU
throttle that is too noisy to block on.
Script 600000, warn. /feed is over it today (728 KB). That is real work, and an error here would
fail every PR for weight none of them added.
These readings predate 2026-11-14. If the first run after this change sits far from them, re-set the
numbers from that run; do not loosen them to get a green.
WHERE THE NUMBERS LAND. The `Report the mobile numbers` step prints medians per URL into the job
summary on every run, from the *.report.json files lighthouse-ci dumps into .lighthouseci-mobile.
Same caveats as lighthouserc.json: a LAB run on a shared runner against a cold preview, three runs
and the median, INP absent because it needs a real interaction. The job runs only on pull requests
labelled full-ci and is not a required check.
